title: The Wrap: Round 11 Clinic, Northern Lights & Double Header Fever

transcript.speaker: Mick
transcript.text: G'day touch footy tragics and welcome to The Wrap! Mick here alongside the tactical guru, Gazza! Gaz, what an absolute ripper out at Cleveland Showgrounds tonight! It was spitting rain early, the boys were huddled under the tin roof like cold chooks, but fair dinkum, right on the hooter, the skies parted for Point Takeaway against the Centurions!

transcript.speaker: Gazza
transcript.text: Haha, g'day Mick! Bloody oath, mate. Noticeably absent was Nev, who has hopped on a big bird flying to the North Pole to see the Northern Lights, lucky bugger. But the lads turned up ready to rip in: Cam, Matt, BJ, Jayden, Reece, Mitch, Mack, Adrian, Joely, Dylan, and Peter. Mind you, minute one was a shocker—Centurions put on some young stepping magic and caught our blokes napping. Nil-one down before we even broke a sweat, mate.

transcript.speaker: Mick
transcript.text: Haha, oh mate, they got stung! And then what about Peter's mystery penalty? Charging in with total fervour, eyes on the prize, and he runs dead straight into his own teammate! You couldn't script it! Jayden had a blistering line break cut short by a fingernail, but then Joely—cool as a cucumber—waltzes right through the middle to lock it at one-all. You beauty!

transcript.speaker: Gazza
transcript.text: Pure class from Joely, mate. Then Cam, pulling the strings at link, drills an absolute rocket—a genuine bullet pass—straight into Mack hitting the gap at full throttle. Two-one. Centurions struck back out wide to make it two-all, despite Mack putting in a heroic diving try-saver earlier. But Mick, that five-minute patch before halftime from our boys was textbook touch footy.

transcript.speaker: Mick
transcript.text: Poetry in motion, Gazza! Peter dishes a peach out to Reece, who turns on the afterburners down the chalk for three-two! Then Dylan and Jayden do a classic give-and-go right through the guts—slippery as eels—bang, four-two right on halftime! Then straight out of the sheds, Mitch pulls off a piece of pure solo brilliance to make it five-two, mate!

transcript.speaker: Gazza
transcript.text: And then, the drama, mate! The ref decides it is time for some crowd entertainment. Double soft send-offs! First, Mack gets marched to the sideline to have a quick breather, and literally twenty seconds later, Joely gets pinged and sent packing too! The sideline is screaming: 'What for?!' and the only answer you get is: 'It's a referee thing!'

transcript.speaker: Mick
transcript.text: Haha, 'It's a referee thing!' Unbelievable, mate! But did it slow the boys down? Not a chance in hell! Centurions cough up a tap near our line, Reece spots grass, someone yells 'No, don't do it!', and Reece just takes off like a bloody missile! Supersonic speed, dotting it down for six-two! Then Adrian breaks some poor defender's ankles in the middle—'You wouldn't know would you? Good step Adrian!'—before Cam caps an endless motor of a performance with the sealer for seven-two!

transcript.speaker: Gazza
transcript.text: Seven-two at full time, mate. The gaffer Graeme was on the sideline giving the official post-match verdict: 'We played near to our best tonight. And it is good. Great to watch.' Strewth, you cannot get a higher stamp of approval than that from Graeme, Mick! Clinical performance right across the park.

transcript.speaker: Mick
transcript.text: Bloody oath, Gaz! Now, let us run the rule over the other Round eleven footy clashes around the grounds. The Touchers took care of business, eight to two over United. Hunt and Kill gave Screws a hiding, six to two. And Bonsai notched an eight-three win over The Well Hungarians. So Gazza mate, have a squiz at the ladder for the punters at home!

transcript.speaker: Gazza
transcript.text: Righto mate, let us have a look! The Touchers sit in first on seventeen points. Hunt and Kill are right beside them in second on seventeen too. But mate, Point Takeaway are breathing right down their necks in third on sixteen points, with a plus-eleven differential. And get this into ya: we have the best attack in the whole comp with forty-seven tries bagged this season! Bonsai are nipping right at our heels in fourth on sixteen points as well.

transcript.speaker: Mick
transcript.text: Forty-seven tries, you little beauty! Absolute try-scoring machine, mate! But strewth Gaz, pull your footy socks up, because next Wednesday, the twenty-first of October, on Field Six... mate, it is the mother of all nights. A MASSIVE double header!

transcript.speaker: Gazza
transcript.text: Lock it in your diary, mate, fair dinkum. Game one kicks off at quarter past eight Brisvegas time against number two, Hunt and Kill. Then just a quick breather before game two at quarter to nine against the table toppers, The Touchers. Back-to-back grudge matches against the top two sides in the comp! If Point Takeaway can sweep both games, mate, the minor premiership is blown wide open!

transcript.speaker: Mick
transcript.text: Haha, stone the crows, it is gonna be bonza! Get down to Cleveland, bring your camp chairs and your aerogard, grab a cold tinny! We will catch you next week on The Wrap—cheers legends!
